findings.highlight: once it embedded itself in me
findings.evidenceJa: 呪文で自己に埋没すれば
findings.governingReading: 呪文で自己に埋没すれば is his conditional inward focusing through reciting the spell, improving Projection.
findings.explanation: Immersing himself by the incantation becomes the incantation embedding itself in him.

findings.highlight: are meant to be reproductions that are treated the same as their originals.
findings.governingReading: 複製でありながら本物と同一のもの asserts the defining identity despite copying.
findings.explanation: Projection identical to the original becomes intended reproductions treated the same.

findings.governingReading: 撃鉄 names the hammer, distinct from 引き金/trigger explicitly in the next line.
findings.explanation: The firing hammer becomes a firing trigger.

findings.highlight: I need to get the fuse itself out of my head, too.
findings.evidenceJa: 入ってしまうスイッチそのものが外に出る
findings.governingReading: The correction says the activating switch itself would be outside, not that extraction prevents activation.
findings.explanation: The switch itself going outside with the gun becomes also needing to remove the fuse.

findings.highlight: I just wanted to relax for a bit.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが仕切り直したかっただけ
findings.governingReading: 仕切り直す is restarting/changing the course, her defensive excuse after stopping the news and bringing tea.
findings.explanation: Wanting to reset becomes wanting to relax.

findings.highlight: I saw some boy at the edge of campus trying over and over to jump a bar that was too high for him, like a moron.
findings.evidenceJa: やっぱりバカみたいに眺めてた
findings.governingReading: やっぱりバカみたいに眺めてた repeats idiot-like for her own watching, alongside his repeated impossible attempts.

findings.highlight: one mystery has been melted, only to be frozen again.
findings.evidenceJa: 氷解したようなさらに凍結したような
findings.governingReading: 氷解したようなさらに凍結したような gives contradictory uncertain impressions of the newly explained hostility.
findings.explanation: Thawed or even further frozen becomes melted then frozen again.

findings.highlight: sometimes, I saw this guy there that wasn't even part of the club.
findings.evidenceJa: たまたまね、部員でもないのにやってきたヤツがいて
findings.governingReading: たまたま a nonmember came while she regularly watched the club; seeing his face then triggers recognition.
findings.explanation: One chance sighting becomes repeated sightings.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka isn't saying this out of humility.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を卑下してはいない
findings.governingReading: 卑下してはいない counters her terrible-person description by denying self-disparagement.
findings.explanation: Not belittling herself becomes not speaking out of humility.

findings.highlight: Life would probably be a lot simpler
findings.evidenceJa: どんなに純粋な事なんだろう
findings.governingReading: 純粋 praises the purity of dedicating oneself without calculating outcomes.
findings.explanation: Single-minded purity becomes a simpler life.

findings.highlight: stands up and declares that break time is over.
findings.evidenceJa: 休憩は終わりだ、と言うかのように
findings.governingReading: と言うかのように qualifies her action as conveying the end of the break without a specified spoken declaration.
findings.explanation: Standing as if saying the break is over becomes an actual declaration.

findings.highlight: She's also got plenty of stamina.
findings.evidenceJa: なら、体力だって充分にあるんじゃないのか
findings.governingReading: なら...充分にあるんじゃないのか is a puzzled conditional question inferred from expected sufficient magical energy.
findings.explanation: Then wouldn’t she have enough stamina becomes she has plenty.

findings.highlight: I don't know what happened to her yesterday.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日の夜何があったのかは知らない
findings.governingReading: 昨日の夜 locates the unknown damaging event specifically at night.
findings.explanation: Not knowing what happened last night loses night.

findings.highlight: the Crest Worms have been feeding heavily
findings.evidenceJa: 体内の刻印虫に食いちぎられた
findings.governingReading: 食いちぎられた is tearing flesh away by biting, paired with the alternative of another agent slicing her up.
findings.explanation: Being torn apart by feeding worms becomes heavy feeding.

findings.highlight: when she started saying things like
findings.evidenceJa: 本音を立て続けに言われた時
findings.governingReading: 本音を立て続けに assigns unguarded true feelings to her successive greetings/wishes as Rin reads them.
findings.explanation: Sakura repeatedly voicing her true feelings becomes simply starting to say the examples.
